fields.description: Prefixes every model id this provider serves (openai/gpt-5), so it is set once. Lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens. One record per Geography shares the name: the id stays the same everywhere and each gateway dials its own geography's record.
fields.label: Provider Name

fields.description: The provider our own engines serve under: a Model with no provider is named here, and only its models can be deployed. Exactly one, and it dials nothing — a URL is what makes a vendor.
fields.label: Self Hosted

fields.description: Where this vendor account processes requests. Only gateways in this geography dial this record, so a regional front (eu.api.openai.com) is a second record under the same Provider Name. Blank for our own engines, which take their geography from wherever they run.
fields.label: Geography

fields.description: Sent as the vendor's version header on every request. Anthropic's is 2023-06-01.
fields.label: API Version

fields.description: How a gateway picks the key for a request: each in turn, in table order, one cursor per vendor across all its models. Whatever is picked, a key answering 429 is swapped for the next once, and one answering 401/402/403 is skipped for the rest of that request.
fields.label: Key Selection
